methodology: First-pass ayah-by-ayah screening using Qur'an text and candidate biblical passage locations. This is NOT primary-text/critical-edition verification. Earlier PR #277 and #93 checked; no claim of exhaustive ledger audit, database access, or source verification. All candidate locators are nonpublic leads.

records.topic: Sabbath violators commanded to become despised apes
records.notes: Biblical Sabbath sanctions include death for violation, but these passages do not narrate transformation into apes.
records.pending_question: Search demonstrably pre-Islamic Jewish/Christian witnesses for animal transformation; distinguish later tafsir and midrash dating.

records.topic: Pronouncement of continuing oppression and divine mercy
records.notes: Covenant curses and enemy oppression are related motifs, but the Qur'anic until-resurrection wording is not reproduced in the cited Torah passages.
records.pending_question: Check source scope and context; avoid presenting punishment as an endorsement of persecution of any contemporary group.

records.topic: Dispersion into communities, righteous and otherwise, tested by fortunes
records.notes: Biblical dispersion and return motifs overlap; Qur'an expressly distinguishes righteous and less righteous communities and tests through prosperity and hardship.
records.pending_question: Compare Hebrew wording and chronology of composition versus extant witnesses; identify whether any precise source matches the mixed communities.

records.topic: Scripture-inheriting successors take worldly gains and assume forgiveness
records.notes: Prophetic critiques of corrupt religious conduct and misplaced confidence in sanctuary/forgiveness are broad thematic analogies, not the same covenant dialogue.
records.pending_question: Examine precise scriptural covenant prohibition on speaking falsely of God and whether source passages directly address financial gains.

records.topic: Those who hold fast scripture and establish prayer are rewarded
records.notes: Adherence to covenant and prayer are broad shared religious themes; no distinctive earlier narrative or wording is established.
records.pending_question: Revisit only if a specific independently dated pre-Islamic text with distinctive correspondence is found.
